recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.
PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.
PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.
